blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual agents must turn video observations into timely decisions to track progress and choose what to do next. Building on the emerging System One paradigm, we introduce VideoJev, a family of models that cast video understanding and interaction as structured decision tasks. We adapt pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by replacing autoregressive answer decoding with a shared head that scores temporal intervals and textual options against video evidence. These scores yield event spans or answer choices, unifying temporal grounding and multiple-choice video question answering. This combines the semantic flexibility of MLLMs with efficient decisions that agents can use directly. As an interaction unfolds, new goals and intermediate results prompt further queries about the same visual history. VideoJev therefore reuses visual computation through Cached inference for queries as they arrive and Joint inference for multiple queries in a single forward pass. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks, VideoJev-4B and VideoJev-35B-A3B improve mean mIoU over their backbones by 6.7 and 10.8 points, respectively, with measured inference speedups of $2.8$-$3.1\times$. On four video QA benchmarks, both achieve performance comparable to their backbones in Thinking mode, with measured inference speedups exceeding $100\times$. These results offer a unified, reusable decision interface for composing structured visual judgments into complex, open-ended workflows.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual intelligence enables systems to perceive, reason about, and interact with the world. For such systems, video understanding must support timely decisions that guide reasoning and action. An agent may need to locate evidence, check progress, or assess possible actions, often using the same visual history. For example, an assistant following a cooking procedure may check whether an ingredient has been added before choosing the next step. High-level goals can be decomposed into conditions to verify and options to evaluate, through predefined procedures or generated plans [ 1 , 47 ] . This suggests a central premise: structured visual judgments can support open-ended behavior without requiring open-ended generation at every step.
blocks.zh: 视觉智能使系统能够感知、理性和与世界互动。 对于这些系统,视频理解必须有助于及时作出指导推理和行动的决定。 代理人可能需要查找证据,检查进度,或评估可能的行动,经常使用相同的视觉历史. 例如,一个从事烹饪程序的助手可以在选择下一步之前检查是否添加了某种成分. 高级别目标可通过预先确定的程序或产生的计划,分解为核查条件和评价备选方案[1、47]。 这表明一个中心前提:结构化的视觉判断可以支持无限制的行为,而不需要每个步骤的无限制一代.

blocks.en: Existing visual models offer complementary strengths. Discriminative vision models make efficient predictions but often depend on task-specific designs or fixed label spaces. Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide broad semantic understanding and flexible language interfaces [ 24 , 51 ] , yet typically express decisions through autoregressive generation. They generate timestamps for temporal grounding [ 35 , 16 , 61 ] or answer text for video question answering [ 23 , 25 ] , even when the output is a compact, structured decision. Our goal is to combine efficient direct prediction with the semantic flexibility of pretrained MLLMs through a unified, language-conditioned interface.
blocks.zh: 现有的视觉模型提供了互补优势. 歧视性的视觉模型能做出高效的预测,但往往取决于特定任务的设计或固定的标签空间. 视频多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)提供了广义的语义理解和灵活的语言界面[24,51],然而通常通过自递生成来表达决定. 它们生成时间定位的时标[35,16,61]或视频问题回答的回答文本[23,25],即使产出是一个紧凑,结构化的决定. 我们的目标是通过统一的,语言条件化的接口,将高效的直接预测与预先训练的MLLMs的语义灵活性结合起来.

blocks.en: The System One paradigm offers a foundation for this goal. Jev produces typed probabilistic judgments that software can use directly, without generating answers token by token [ 2 , 38 ] . Recent work extends this idea to images [ 48 , 58 ] . Video introduces an additional requirement: decisions must reflect temporal structure while sharing expensive visual context across queries. When successive questions share the same observations, the cost of each additional judgment becomes central to responsive interaction.
blocks.zh: 系统 一个范例为实现这一目标提供了基础。 Jev生成软件可以直接使用的打字概率判断,而无需通过符号生成答案符号[2,38]. 最近的工作将这个想法扩展到图像[48,58]. 视频提出了额外要求:决定必须反映时间结构,同时在各种查询中分享昂贵的视觉环境。 当连续的问题有相同的意见时,每个附加判断的成本成为反应互动的核心.

blocks.en: We introduce VideoJev , a family of video System One models built around two principles: direct candidate scoring and reusable visual computation (Figure 1 ). Temporal grounding scores intervals for membership in a queried event and assembles them into a contiguous span. Multiple-choice video question answering (Video QA) scores textual options and selects the answer best supported by the video. Both tasks share a scoring architecture, while task-specific supervision and output rules preserve their different structures. This design draws on pretrained multimodal representations without autoregressive answer decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍VideoJev, 一个由视频系统一号模型组成的家族, 在被质询的事件中,临时确定会员的得分间隔并将其组合成一个毗连的周期。 多选择视频问答(Video QA)对文本选项进行评分,并选择视频最佳支持的答案. 这两项任务都共享评分架构,而针对具体任务的监督与产出规则则保留其不同的架构. 这种设计借鉴了事先经过训练的多式联运表示法,没有自动解码的答案.

blocks.en: To support repeated judgments, VideoJev organizes training and inference around a shared video prefix. In Cached inference , the video is encoded and prefilled once, and queries reuse the cached context as they arrive. In Joint inference , multiple queries follow the same prefix and receive separate scores in one causal forward pass. Training uses the same layout to share computation across questions.
blocks.zh: 为了支持重复的判决,视频 Jev围绕一个共享视频前缀组织培训和推论. 在 Cached 推论中, 视频被编码并预填一次, 并查询缓存上下文的再使用情况 。 联合推断中,多个查询都跟随同一个前缀,在一个因果前传中获得单独的分数. 训练使用相同的布局来分享问题之间的计算.

blocks.en: We evaluate VideoJev-4B, a dense model, and VideoJev-35B-A3B, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, on three temporal grounding and four Video QA benchmarks. Relative to their Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B backbones in Instruct mode, the two models improve mean grounding mIoU by 6.7 and 10.8 points and mean QA scores by 8.0 and 5.7 points, respectively (Tables 1 and 2 ). Measured inference speedups reach 2.8 2.8 – 3.1 × 3.1\times for grounding; on QA, both remain competitive with their Thinking counterparts while achieving over 𝟏𝟎𝟎 × 100\times speedups. The timed generative baselines also reuse the video prefix.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了VideoJev-4B,一个密集的模型,以及VideoJev-35B-A3B,一个专家混合模型,以三个时间定位和四个视频QA基准. 相对于其在指令模式下的Quen3.5-4B和Quen3.6-35B-A3B骨干,两种模式分别以6.7分和10.8分改进平均地面mIoU,以8.0分和5.7分分别改进平均QA分(表1和表2). 测量到的推论速度达到2.8 2.8 — 3.1 × 3.1\时间进行搁浅;在QA上,两者都保持与思考对手的竞争,同时实现100×100\时间的加速. 定时基因基线也重新使用视频前缀.

blocks.en: With identical training data and settings, VideoJev-4B also exceeds autoregressive fine-tuning by 1.3 points in mean grounding mIoU and 1.9 points in mean QA score (Table 3 ), supporting the benefit of direct decision learning beyond data alone. These findings support learning structured judgments for visual agents.
blocks.zh: 由于培训数据和设置相同,VideoJev-4B在平均定位mIoU和平均QA分数(表3)中也超过1.3分的自旋微调,支持直接决策学习在数据之外的好处。 这些调查结果支持为视觉代理人学习结构化判断。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce VideoJev, a family of video System One models that unifies temporal grounding and multiple-choice Video QA through direct candidate scoring. • We reuse visual computation across training queries and through two inference modes: Cached inference for arriving queries and Joint inference for queries processed together. • We evaluate dense 4B and MoE 35B-A3B models across seven benchmarks, demonstrating strong prediction quality and inference efficiency, with a controlled comparison against autoregressive fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们介绍VideoJev,一个由视频系统一号模型组成的家族,通过直接候选人评分统一时间定位和多选择视频QA。 我们通过各种培训查询和两种推论模式重新利用视觉计算: • 对抵达的询问进行推论,对一起处理的询问进行联合推论。 我们评价了7个基准的密集4B和MOE 35B-A3B模型,显示出强大的预测质量和推论效率,并与自旋微调进行有控制的比较。

blocks.en: Given a video V V , a language query q q , and K K candidates C = { c 1 , … , c K } C=\{c_{1},\ldots,c_{K}\} , we place video tokens first, followed by the task instruction, query, and candidate list. The instruction specifies temporal grounding or multiple-choice Video QA. Each candidate ends with <|option_end|> , and the list ends with <|decide|> . Causal modeling lets candidate readouts use the video, query, and preceding candidates; the decision readout sees the full list. Temporal candidates are timestamp texts copied from the video prefix into this list, each identifying a frame-pair interval. Their sigmoid scores indicate event membership, from which we decode a contiguous span. Option candidates are answer texts; softmax normalizes their logits into probabilities for selecting the highest-scoring option. Thus, candidates and output rules specify the task.

blocks.en: Causal modeling makes the video prefix independent of subsequent queries, allowing its computation to be shared. In Cached inference , we encode and prefill the video once. Each arriving query branches from the cached prefix and requires one language-model forward over its query, candidates, and readout tokens. In Joint inference , multiple queries and their candidate lists follow a single video prefix, with a separate <|decide|> readout for each query. One causal language-model forward pass yields all query scores. Later queries can access preceding query text and candidates, but no reference or predicted answers are appended. Training uses the same concatenated query layout to share video computation across questions for efficiency.

blocks.en: 2.2 Temporal Grounding through Interval Decisions
blocks.zh: 2.2 通过间隔决定确定时间

blocks.en: An event may span many candidate intervals. Grounding therefore requires both identifying relevant intervals and covering the event as a whole. We train these complementary judgments with local membership and coverage supervision, then decode a single continuous span.

blocks.en: 2.4 Training Recipe
blocks.zh: 2.4 培训工具

blocks.en: We instantiate VideoJev with Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Scoring-head projection weights are initialized from a Gaussian with standard deviation 0.005; biases start at zero.
blocks.zh: 我们用Quen3.5-4B和Quen3.6-35B-A3B对VideoJev进行即时攻击. Scoring-head投影权重从高斯琴初始化,标准偏差为0.005;偏差从零开始.

blocks.en: We train temporal membership on TimeLens-100K [ 55 ] and TimeLens2-93K [ 61 ] , converting annotated intervals into candidate-level labels. Option selection uses an internally curated corpus of approximately 240K multiple-choice questions over 19K videos. The content includes gaming, sports, cooking, music and dance, outdoor activities, and crafts. Questions cover entity and action recognition, spatiotemporal reasoning, information retrieval, event understanding, counting, OCR, and summarization. Videos range from 4 minutes to nearly 2 hours, and each question has four or five answer options. We group queries from the same video around a shared prefix.
blocks.zh: 我们在TimeLens-100K[55]和TimeLens2-93K[61]上培训时间成员,将附加说明的间隔转换为候选人级别的标签. 选项选择使用一个包含大约240K个多选题的内部目录,其中包含19K视频. 内容包括游戏、体育、烹饪、音乐和舞蹈、户外活动以及手工艺品。 问题包括实体和行动识别、瞬间推理、信息检索、事件理解、计数、OCR和总结。 视频从4分钟到近2小时不等,每个问题都有四,五个答案选项. 我们把同一个视频的询问 围绕一个共享的前缀。

blocks.en: Inspired by projector alignment in MLLMs [ 28 ] , we first train the new scorer against fixed pretrained features, then adapt the language backbone. This gives the scorer a stable representation space during its initial updates. Stage one trains only the head on 30% of the videos, with the backbone and new marker embeddings frozen. blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate prediction quality and inference efficiency on grounding and multiple-choice Video QA, then examine model design and confidence. Unless otherwise stated, VideoJev uses Joint inference .
blocks.zh: 我们评价地面上的预测质量和推断效率以及多选择视频QA,然后审查模型设计和信心。 除非另有说明,VideoJev使用联合推论.

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We train both model sizes on 64 NVIDIA H200 GPUs with BF16 computation and a global batch size of 64 packed sequences. Training videos are sampled at 2 fps, with a maximum sequence length of 144K tokens and an 80% visual-token budget. We use AdamW with weight decay 0.01 and gradient clipping at 1.0. Each stage uses 5% warm-up followed by cosine decay to 10% of its peak learning rate. The head learning rate is 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} during head alignment and 10 − 4 10^{-4} during joint adaptation. In the latter stage, the language-backbone learning rate is 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} for 4B and 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} for 35B-A3B. The two stages run for 160 and 375 optimizer updates, respectively. We use DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 for 4B and ZeRO-3 for 35B-A3B.

blocks.en: We evaluate on the TimeLens-Bench refined annotations [ 55 ] of Charades-STA [ 12 ] , ActivityNet Captions [ 19 ] , and QVHighlights [ 21 ] . For each query, we report rank-one recall at temporal IoU thresholds 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7 (R1@0.3/0.5/0.7), together with mean temporal IoU (mIoU). VideoJev uses a fixed decoding threshold τ = 0.25 \tau=0.25 and smoothing window 1 across both model sizes and all inference modes.

blocks.en: We evaluate multiple-choice Video QA on the LVBench [ 41 ] test set (1,549 questions), Video-MME [ 11 ] test set (2,700 questions), LongVideoBench [ 42 ] validation set (1,337 questions), and the seven multiple-choice tasks of MLVU [ 57 ] development (2,174 questions). Inputs contain video frames only, without subtitles or audio. We report accuracy on LVBench, Video-MME, and LongVideoBench, and M-Avg on MLVU.

Both tasks measure model forward time only, excluding preprocessing and data transfers. VideoJev uses Joint inference , encoding each video once and scoring its queries together. Generative baselines share visual encoding and prefix prefill, then generate answers from independent query branches. We divide accumulated forward time, including visual encoding, prefill, and all autoregressive decoding steps, by the number of queries. Generations reaching the output limit are included. blocks.en: 3.2 Video Temporal Grounding
blocks.zh: 3.2 录像时间定位

blocks.en: Table 1 shows consistent gains across the three grounding benchmarks. VideoJev-4B reaches 65.3 mean mIoU, improving on Qwen3.5-4B by 6.7 points and TimeLens2-4B by 3.3 points. Against TimeLens2-4B, it also raises R1@0.7 by 2.8–4.8 points across the three datasets. Gains under this stricter overlap criterion indicate more precise temporal localization, supporting interval membership scoring as an effective way to recover event spans.
blocks.zh: 表1显示三个基准的一致收益。 视频 Jev-4B达到65.3 平均mIoU,在Quen3.5-4B上提高6.7分,在TimeLens2-4B上提高3.3分. 与TimeLens2-4B相对,它也会将R1@0.7在三个数据集之间提升2.8–4.8分. 根据这一更严格的重叠标准,收益表明时间定位更为精确,支持间隔成员评分作为恢复事件跨度的有效途径。

blocks.en: VideoJev-35B-A3B raises mean mIoU to 67.7, 10.8 points above its Qwen3.6-35B-A3B backbone. Scaling from VideoJev-4B adds 2.4 points with only a 22% increase in measured latency. Both sizes lead all reported grounding metrics and achieve the lowest measured latency within their respective open-source groups, with 2.8 2.8 – 3.1 × 3.1\times speedups over their backbones. Since the generative baselines also share video prefill, these speedups highlight the value of avoiding autoregressive timestamp generation when repeated queries draw on the same visual context.

Architectural, objective, and schedule ablations use VideoJev-4B with the same complete test sets, Joint inference , and grounding decoder. QA ablations and the autoregressive control retain the fixed 256K-token context; tables report changes from the marked baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们控制培训数据,然后审查推断模式、任务组成、监督和设计选择。 建筑,客观,时间表的调试使用VideoJev-4B,具有相同的完整测试集,联合推论,以及地面解码器. QA 分解和自动回转控制保留了固定的256K位上下文;表格报告从标记的基线变化。

blocks.en: To test whether the gains arise solely from our training data, we fine-tune an ordinary Qwen3.5-4B autoregressive model on exactly the same post-training data as VideoJev. It retains the native final MLP and language-model head and learns to generate temporal intervals or answer letters. Both models use single-stage training on 100% of the data; VideoJev results are copied from the single-stage variant in Table 8 . Table 3 shows that VideoJev improves mean grounding and QA scores by 1.3 and 1.9 points. The gains under matched data and schedules support an architectural benefit: directly supervising temporal membership and option preferences aligns the readout with the required decisions, enabling more effective use of the same supervision. Appendix A.3 gives the key settings.
blocks.zh: 为了检验这些收益是否完全来自我们的训练数据,我们用和VideoJev完全相同的训练后数据来微调一个普通的Quen3.5-4B自递模型. 它保留了本土最终的MLP和语言模型头,并学习产生时间间隔或答字母. 两个模型都使用关于100%数据的单阶段培训;VideoJev结果从表8中的单阶段变体复制出来. 表3显示,VideoJev提高了平均地基分和质量保证分数1.3和1.9分。 匹配数据和时间表下的收益支持一种建筑效益:直接监督时间成员资格和选择偏好,使宣读与必要的决定保持一致,从而能够更有效地利用同样的监督。 附录A.3提供了关键设置。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Isolating architectural gains with an autoregressive control. VideoJev-4B and an autoregressive Qwen3.5-4B are both fine-tuned in a single stage on exactly the same post-training data. † \dagger denotes the VideoJev-4B Single-stage (100%) variant from Table 8 . The two models share the same training and evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 表3:采用自动控制隔离式建筑收益。 VideoJev-4B和自动回转的Quen3.5-4B均在完全相同的训练后数据上在单阶段进行微调. ^\dagger表示表8中的VideoJev-4B单级(100%)变体. 这两种模式的培训和评价环境相同。

blocks.en: Cached inference evaluates each query independently against the same video prefix, providing a reference without interference between queries. Joint inference efficiently scores all queries in a group in one forward pass. To retain the benefits of optimized kernels such as FlashAttention, it uses standard causal attention without custom masks to isolate queries. Later queries can therefore attend to preceding questions and candidates. We verified that earlier questions do not leak answers to later ones; no reference or predicted answers are inserted. Table 4 tests whether these interactions degrade prediction quality using the same trained checkpoint within each size. Surprisingly, Joint inference improves mean grounding/QA scores by 0.8/0.5 points at 4B and 0.3/0.7 points at 35B-A3B. Scores improve in 13 of the 14 model–benchmark comparisons, with only a 0.1-point decrease on QVHighlights at 35B-A3B. These small gains may reflect alignment with training, which uses the same joint layout for efficiency: the model learns to accommodate query interactions while sharing visual computation.
blocks.zh: Crached 推论将每个查询独立地与同一个视频前缀进行评价,在查询之间提供无干扰的参考. 联合推论将一组中的所有查询都有效地分到一个前传中。 为了保留优化内核如FlashAttenty的好处,它使用标准因果注意而不使用自定义面具来隔离查询. 因此,以后的询问可以处理前面的问题和候选人。 我们核实,先前的问题不会泄露给后来的问题;没有插入参考或预测的答案。 表4测试这些相互作用是否利用每个尺寸内训练有素的同一检查站降低预测质量。 令人惊讶的是,联合推论在4B时提高了平均地基/QA分数的0.8/0.5分,在35B-A3B时提高了0.3/0.7分. 14个型号中13个型号的比分有所改进,在35B-A3B的QVHighlights上只有0.1分的下降. 这些小收益可能反映了与训练的配合,训练使用相同的联合布局来提高效率:模型学习在共享视觉计算的同时适应查询互动.

blocks.en: Table 4 : Cached inference versus Joint inference.
blocks.zh: 表4:缓推与联合推论。

blocks.en: Temporal grounding and video QA require different forms of prediction: localizing an event in time and selecting a textual answer. We therefore examine whether the two tasks interfere, remain independent, or reinforce each other within VideoJev. Table 5 compares VideoJev-4B trained jointly on both tasks with models trained on either task alone. Joint training improves performance on all seven benchmarks, raising mean grounding mIoU by 0.7 points and mean QA score by 1.3 points, with the largest QA gain on LongVideoBench (+1.9 points). These gains indicate mutual benefit: temporal supervision may sharpen evidence localization, while QA strengthens semantic discrimination. The shared scorer provides a simple interface for learning these complementary capabilities.
blocks.zh: Timoral rounding and video QA需要不同形式的预测:及时将一个事件定位,并选择文字答案. 因此,我们审查这两项任务是干涉、保持独立,还是在VideoJev内部相互加强。 表5将联合接受两项任务培训的VideoJev-4B与接受单独一项任务培训的模型进行比较。 联合训练提高了所有7个基准的性能,使mIoU的平均基数提高了0.7分,平均QA得分提高了1.3分,在LongVideo Bench(+1.9分)上的QA增益最大. 这些收益表明互利:时间监督可能强化证据本地化,而质量保证则强化语义歧视。 共享计分器为学习这些互补能力提供了一个简单的界面.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Joint versus single-task training. VideoJev-4B is trained on temporal grounding (TG), video question answering (QA), or both.
blocks.zh: 表5:联合培训与单一任务培训。 视频 Jev-4B在时间定位(TG),视频问答(QA)或两者都接受了培训.

blocks.en: Correct local judgments must also cover the event as a whole. Table 6 tests the value of adding Soft IoU to the grounding objective in Eq. ( 7 ), while QA retains cross-entropy. Soft IoU raises mean grounding mIoU from 60.7 to 65.3 ( +4.6 points) and mean QA score from 73.9 to 74.3 ( +0.4 points), with improvements on all seven benchmarks. These results highlight the value of event-level coverage supervision and suggest that better temporal learning also benefits the shared representations used for QA.
blocks.zh: 正确的当地判决也必须涵盖整个事件。 表6测试在Eq.(7)中将Soft IoU添加到地基目标上的值,而QA保留了交叉内质. 软IoU将平均基数mIoU从60.7升至65.3(+4.6分),平均QA分数从73.9升至74.3(+0.4分),所有7个基准都有改进. 这些结果凸显了事件一级覆盖监督的价值,并表明更好的时间学习也有利于质量保证所用的共同表述。

blocks.en: Table 6 : Effect of Soft IoU supervision in VideoJev-4B. Soft IoU augments the grounding BCE objective; QA retains cross-entropy. Deltas are relative to BCE/CE only (baseline). Both variants use two-stage training.
blocks.zh: 表6:VideoJev-4B中软IoU监督的效果. 软IoU能增强BCE的地基目标;QA保留跨内质. 三角洲仅相对于BCE/CE(基线). 两个变体都采用两级训练.

blocks.en: The final MLP adds a transformation before candidate scoring, but Table 7 shows that it is not needed to maintain prediction quality. Removing it raises mean grounding and QA scores by 0.2 points each, leaving overall performance essentially unchanged. Following Occam’s razor, we adopt the simpler readout: pre-MLP features preserve both capabilities while avoiding an additional layer of computation.
blocks.zh: 最终的MLP在考生得分前增加了一个转变,但表7显示不需要保持预测质量. 删除后,平均基数和质量保证分数各提高0.2分,总体业绩基本不变。 在Occam剃须刀之后,我们采用更简单的读出:MLP前功能既能保留两种能力,又能避免额外的计算层。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Effect of the final-layer MLP in VideoJev-4B.
blocks.zh: 表7:VideoJev-4B中末级MLP的影响.

blocks.en: The two-stage schedule first aligns the scorer with frozen features, then adapts the language backbone and scorer together. Table 8 shows broadly comparable performance to single-stage training: two-stage adaptation scores slightly higher on four of seven benchmarks, while single-stage training leads by only 0.1 point in mean grounding mIoU and 0.4 points in mean QA, mainly due to MLVU. Two-stage adaptation achieves this quality while updating the language backbone on only 70% of the videos; the remaining 30% use cheaper head-only training. We adopt this schedule for its lower cost and comparable performance; aligning the scorer first may also stabilize backbone adaptation.
blocks.zh: 两阶段的计分表首先将计分器与冷冻特征对齐,然后将语言骨干和计分器一起调整. 表8显示了与单阶段培训大致相当的性能:两个阶段的适应分数略高于七个基准中的四个,而单阶段培训在平均着陆mIoU和平均QA中分别领先0.1分和0.4分,这主要是由于MLVU造成的. 两阶段的改编实现了这一质量,同时仅更新了70%视频的语言主干线;其余30%使用更便宜的仅头训练. 我们采用这一时间表是为了降低成本和具有可比性的性能;首先调整计分器也可以稳定骨干适应。

blocks.en: Table 8 : Two-stage versus single-stage adaptation of VideoJev-4B. The baseline warms up the head on 30% of videos and jointly adapts on the remaining 70%; single-stage training directly adapts on all videos with the full objectives.
blocks.zh: 表8:VideoJev-4B的两阶段对单阶段改编. 基线在30%的视频上加热头部,并联合调整其余70%的视频;单阶段培训在所有视频上直接调整,目标全部.

blocks.en: 3.5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.5 分析

blocks.en: Figure 3 compares the computational efficiency of Cached inference and Joint inference as the number of queries about the same video increases. VideoJev supports both modes. Autoregressive QA supports joint processing in Direct mode, which predicts exactly one option token without reasoning. Multi-token outputs, including temporal intervals and reasoning traces, require sequential token feedback and use Cached inference . Appendix A.4 details these modes.
blocks.zh: 图3比较了Cached推论和联合推论的计算效率,因为关于同一视频的查询次数有所增加。 视频 Jev支持两种模式. 自动递归QA支持在Direct模式下进行联合处理,这种模式在没有推理的情况下,精确预测一个选项符号. 多键输出,包括时间间隔和推理痕迹,需要顺序符号反馈并使用Cached推论. 附录A.4详细列出了这些模式。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Multi-query efficiency at 4B. Mean forward time for 1–10 queries per video on Charades (a) and Video-Holmes [ 6 ] (b); shading shows 95% confidence intervals. Solid/dotted lines use Cached inference (dotted: multi-token generation); dashed lines use Joint inference . End labels pair ten-query latency with separately evaluated full-benchmark Charades mIoU or LVBench accuracy; quality settings follow the source evaluations in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 图3:4B的多焦效率。 Charades(a)和Video-Holmes[6](b)的每段视频1至10次查询的平均前期时间;阴影显示95%的置信间隔。 固/虚线使用 Cached 推论(doted: multi-toke generation);虚线使用 Joint 推论 . 端标签配对10-query latency,并有单独评价的全基准Charades mIoU或LV Bench精度;质量设置遵循附录A.2中的源评价.

blocks.en: We measure 1–10 queries about the same video at batch size 1, counting visual encoding and prefix prefill once. For each task, we randomly sample 40 videos within duration strata. End labels report full-benchmark Charades mIoU and LVBench accuracy. Quality is evaluated separately from timing; Appendices A.1 and A.2 specify the respective protocols and remaining score sources.
blocks.zh: 我们在1号批量时测量了1–10个关于同一视频的查询,计算了一次视觉编码和前缀前填充. 对于每一项任务,我们随机抽取40个视频 在持续片段。 末端标签报告全基准Charades mIoU和LV Bench精度. 质量与计时分开评价; 附录A.1和A.2分别规定了各自的协议和剩余的计分来源.

blocks.en: VideoJev’s Joint inference adds only 55 ms for grounding and 31 ms for QA as query count grows from one to ten. At ten queries, forward times are 0.39 s and 1.64 s, versus 0.85 s and 2.17 s under Cached inference , while independently measured Charades mIoU and LVBench accuracy improve by 1.5 and 0.8 points, respectively. The autoregressive Direct QA baseline benefits less from joint processing: its accuracy drops from 60.0% under Cached inference to 58.7% under Joint inference , below VideoJev’s 67.9% at comparable latency (1.67 s versus 1.64 s). Multi-token generation remains costly: Qwen3.5-4B Instruct takes 5.98 s for ten grounding queries at 52.3 mIoU, versus VideoJev’s 0.39 s and 60.1 mIoU; Qwen Thinking takes 1,393 s for ten QA queries at 66.4% accuracy. The small marginal cost comes without a loss in prediction quality.
blocks.zh: VideoJev的联合推论只增加了55 ms的地面和31 ms的QA, 在十次查询中,前置时间分别为0.39秒和1.64秒,在Cached推断下为0.85秒和2.17秒,而独立测量的Charades mIoU和LV Bench精度则分别提高了1.5和0.8分. 自动递减的直接质量评估基线收益较少:其精确度从Cached推论下的60.0%下降到联合推论下的58.7%,低于VideoJev的67.9%,其相对延迟度为1.67比1.64。 多箱一代的费用仍然很高: 文3.5-4B号 在52.3 mIoU对 VideoJev 0.39 s 和 60.1 mIoU 的十次问询中, 需要5.98 s; Quen 思考以66.4%的精度进行10次质检查询,需要1,393 s. 微小的边际成本不会造成预测质量的损失。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Confidence calibration on Video QA. Points show mean confidence and observed accuracy in equal-width bins containing at least 20 questions; all bins contribute to ECE. The dashed diagonal denotes perfect calibration. MLVU uses seven-task-balanced weights; the other benchmarks weight questions equally. Curves use the reported per-benchmark predictions.
blocks.zh: 图4:视频QA上的可信度校准。 点对至少包含20个问题的同等宽度的垃圾箱表现出了真正的信心和观察到的准确性;所有垃圾箱都为欧洲经委会做出了贡献。 破碎的对角表示完美的校准. MLVU使用7个任务平衡加权;其他基准加权问题相同. 曲线使用报告的每个基准的预测.

blocks.en: Candidate scores also provide a signal for deciding when to trust a prediction. We examine the highest option probability, max i ⁡ p i \max_{i}p_{i} , using the predictions from Table 2 . Higher confidence generally accompanies higher accuracy (Figure 4 ). On LVBench, the 35B-A3B model reaches 95.8% accuracy on its 591 predictions with confidence at least 99%, compared with 73.4% overall. This separation suggests potential for selecting reliable answers or escalating uncertain cases.
blocks.zh: 候选人得分也为决定何时相信预测提供了信号。 根据表2的预测, 信心的提高一般伴随着精度的提高(图4)。 在LV Bench上,35B-A3B模型在591的预测中达到95.8%的准确度,置信度至少为99%,而总体为73.4%。 这种分离表明有可能选择可靠的答案或不断升级的不确定情况。

blocks.en: Calibration requires confidence to match the frequency of correct predictions [ 14 , 15 ] . Jev explicitly optimizes this property through reinforcement learning [ 2 ] ; VideoJev receives no calibration-specific training. Its probabilities tend to overestimate correctness: the four-benchmark mean expected calibration error (ECE; ten equal-width bins) is 8.65 and 8.13 percentage points for 4B and 35B-A3B. Temperature scaling on an independent calibration set [ 15 ] or calibration-aware training could address this gap.
blocks.zh: 校准需要自信来匹配正确预测的频率[14,15]. Jev通过强化学习明确优化此属性 [2]; 视频 Jev没有接受具体校准训练。 其概率往往会高估正确性:四个基准表示预期校准误差(ECE;10个等宽箱)为8.65分,4B和35B-A3B为8.13个百分点. 在独立校准集 [15] 或校准-意识训练上的温度缩放可以弥补这一差距。

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: VideoChat [ 22 ] and Video-LLaMA [ 53 ] connect visual representations to language models for instruction-driven video understanding. VideoChat2 [ 23 ] and VideoChat3 [ 25 ] expand these capabilities through multimodal training and diverse supervision. For long videos, VideoChat-Flash [ 24 ] compresses visual tokens, while Video-o3 [ 51 ] interleaves reasoning with visual clue seeking. VideoLLM-online [ 5 ] supports streaming interaction with continuous cache reuse, and StreamingVLM [ 44 ] maintains a bounded cache for long-running video streams. JoyAI-VL-Interaction [ 46 ] learns when to remain silent, respond, or delegate during real-time interaction, while OneStreamer [ 50 ] jointly models streaming perception, memory formation, and proactive response. Complementary work studies vision-language transfer in AWT [ 59 ] and efficient test-time prompt adaptation [ 63 ] . Benchmarks probe compositional understanding in TVQA [ 20 ] , temporal and causal reasoning in NExT-QA [ 43 ] , long-horizon understanding in EgoSchema [ 29 ] , and broader video skills in MVBench and Video-MME [ 23 , 11 ] . VideoJev focuses on direct decisions over time and options, sharing an encoded video context across multiple queries.
blocks.zh: VideoChat [22]和Video-LLaMA [53]将视觉表现与语言模型连接起来,用于教学驱动的视频理解. 视频聊天2 [23] 和视频 Chat3[25]通过多式联运培训和多种监督扩大这些能力。 长视频,视频 Chat-Flash [24] 压缩视觉符号,而Video-o3 [51] 则与视觉线索进行交互推理. VideoLLM-online [5] 支持与连续缓存再利用的流式交互,StreamingVLM [44] 为长期运行的视频流维持一个有边界的缓存. JoyAI-VL-Interactive [46] 学习在实时互动中何时保持缄默,回应,或授权,而OneStreamer [50] 联合模式流传感知,内存形成,主动反应. AWT[59]的辅助性工作研究远景语言转移和高效测试时间快速适应[63]. 基准探究TVQA[20]中的组成理解,NExT-QA[43]中的时间和因果推理,EgoSchema中的长视野理解[29],以及MV Bench和Video-MME中更广泛的视频技能[23,11]. 视频 Jev专注于随着时间和选项的直接决定,在多个查询中共享一个编码视频上下文.

blocks.en: Temporal grounding localizes language-described events through candidate matching [ 12 , 56 ] , span prediction [ 54 ] , moment-set prediction [ 21 ] , or clip-level foreground, boundary, and saliency outputs [ 27 ] . In temporal action detection, DualDETR [ 60 ] jointly refines instance and boundary queries. TimeChat and VTimeLLM bring temporal grounding into video MLLMs [ 35 , 16 ] ; LITA and Grounded-VideoLLM introduce explicit temporal tokens [ 17 , 39 ] . TimeSuite uses grounded tuning to improve long-video understanding [ 49 ] , and TimeLens2 advances generalist temporal modeling [ 61 ] . DisTime predicts boundary distributions [ 52 ] , while controlled comparisons examine temporal output designs [ 18 ] . Recent analysis also extracts temporal evidence from prefill attention to guide subsequent answer generation [ 10 ] . Grounding and QA have already been combined: GroundVQA uses a temporal localizer and an answer decoder [ 9 ] , while SEAL learns compact representations for both tasks [ 40 ] . VideoJev uses a shared scoring head for temporal membership and textual options, decoding a contiguous span from temporal scores.
blocks.zh: 通过匹配[12,56],跨度预测[54],瞬间设定预测[21],或剪切级前景、边界和显著输出[27],将语言描述的事件定位。 在时间动作探测中,DualDETR[60]联合改进了实例和边界查询. 时间 Chat和VTimeLLM将时间定位带入视频MLLMs [35, 16];LITA和Grounded-VideoLM引入了明确的时间符号[17, 39]. TimeSite使用有底调来提高长视频理解[49],TimeLens2推进通论时间模型[61]. Distime预测边界分布[52],而控制比较则检查时间输出设计[18]. 最近的分析还从预填注意力中提取时间证据,以指导后续的答案生成[10]. 地面定位和质量保证已经合并: GroundVQA使用时间定位器和解码器[9],而海豹突击队则为这两个任务学习紧凑的表示[40]. 视频 Jev对时间会员和文本选项使用共享积分头,从时间积分中解码一个毗连的跨度.

blocks.en: Jev [ 2 , 38 ] introduces typed probabilistic judgments, while this-that-model-1.0 and JevLite explore one-pass decision readouts [ 7 , 36 ] . Visual Jev [ 48 ] evaluates multiple forced-choice questions over a shared image, and PixelJev [ 58 ] supports image recognition and multiple-choice VQA. FreeRet [ 62 ] extracts multimodal representations and reranks candidates using an MLLM’s multiple-choice probabilities; its reranker can be viewed as a training-free route to Jev-style relevance judgments. Related video studies assess quality from metadata and derived features [ 37 ] or anomalies from captions and summaries [ 32 ] . VideoJev extends this paradigm to temporal decisions and repeated video queries, aligning multi-query training with inference.
blocks.zh: Jev [2,38] 引入了打字概率判断,而这个-该型号-1.0和JevLite则探索了单传决读[7,36]. Visual Jev [48] 在共享图像上评价多个强制选择问题,PixelJev [58] 支持图像识别和多选择 VQA. FreeRet [62] 利用 MLLM 的多选择概率来提取多模式表达并重新排序候选人;其重新排序可以看作是通往Jev 风格相关判断的无培训途径. 相关视频研究评估元数据和衍生特征的质量[37]或标题和摘要的异常[32]。 视频 Jev将这一范式延伸至时间决定和重复的视频查询,使多凯里训练与推论一致.

blocks.en: 5 Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 未来工作

blocks.en: Beyond temporal grounding and multiple-choice Video QA, tasks such as action recognition, event detection, scene-state classification, and visual condition verification can also be formulated as decisions over candidate hypotheses. Extending the candidate interface to these tasks and output structures could reduce reliance on task-specific models and prediction heads.
blocks.zh: 除了时间定位和多选择视频QA之外,诸如动作识别,事件检测,场景状态分类,以及视觉条件核实等任务也可以被制定为对候选假说的决定. 将候选接口扩大到这些任务和产出结构可以减少对特定任务模型和预测头的依赖。

blocks.en: A higher-level agent could decompose open-ended goals into visual checks using standard operating procedures or generated plans. It could propose candidate events, actions, or states for VideoJev to evaluate, then use these judgments to guide planning and execution. Ambiguous or unexpected observations could trigger candidate revision or further reasoning. Here, System Two organizes the decision space, while System One evaluates it against visual evidence . Applications include procedural monitoring, interactive assistance, embodied agents, and computer-use systems.
blocks.zh: 更高级别的代理人可以利用标准操作程序或生成的计划,将开放式目标分解为视觉检查。 它可以提出可供VideoJev评估的候选活动、行动或州,然后利用这些判决指导规划和执行。 模棱两可或意料之外的意见可能会引发候选人的修订或进一步推理。 在这里,系统 有两个组织决定空间, 应用包括程序监测、互动援助、内含物剂和计算机使用系统。

blocks.en: Streaming inputs will require incremental visual encoding, efficient memory management, and timely updates to the decision context. Reliability also needs improvement: higher confidence generally accompanies higher Video QA accuracy, but predicted probabilities tend to overestimate correctness. Calibration-aware training, uncertainty estimation, and selective prediction could help determine when to accept System One decisions or defer to higher-level reasoning.
blocks.zh: 精简投入将需要递增的视觉编码、有效的内存管理以及及时更新决策背景。 可靠性也需要改进:信心的提高一般伴随着视频QA的精度提高,但预测概率往往会高估正确性. 校准意识培训、不确定性估计和选择性预测可有助于确定何时接受系统一的决定或服从更高层次的推理。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced VideoJev, a family of video System One models that unifies temporal grounding and multiple-choice video QA through direct candidate scoring. Cached inference and Joint inference make repeated judgments efficient by reusing visual computation. Across seven benchmarks, dense 4B and MoE 35B-A3B models achieve strong prediction quality and inference efficiency. Ablations show that these gains extend beyond training data alone and that the two tasks benefit from joint learning. VideoJev thus offers a foundation for visual agents that compose structured judgments into complex, open-ended workflows.
blocks.zh: 我们引进了VideoJev, 一组视频系统一, 通过直接候选人评分来统一时间定位和多选择视频QA。 缓推和联合推论通过重用直观计算,使反复判断高效. 在7个基准中,密集的4B和MOE 35B-A3B模型实现了强的预测质量和推论效率. 差距表明,这些成果不仅仅限于培训数据,而且这两项任务都得益于联合学习。 视频 因此,Jev为将结构化判断编成复杂、开放式工作流程的视觉代理提供了基础。

blocks.en: Both tasks use initially idle H200 GPUs at batch size 1. blocks.en: A.4 Inference Modes and Direct Baseline
blocks.zh: A.4 推断模式和直接基线

blocks.en: Cached inference encodes and prefills the video once, then processes queries sequentially from independent copies of the prefix cache. Each branch contains only its query and any generated tokens, without query or answer history. Joint inference concatenates queries after one video prefix and reads all predictions in one causal forward. Later queries can attend to earlier queries, but no reference or predicted answers are inserted. Both modes use batch size 1.
blocks.zh: 缓存推论编码并预填视频一次,然后从前缀缓存的独立副本中依次处理查询. 每个分支只包含它的查询和任何生成的令牌,没有查询或回答历史. 在一个视频前缀后,联合推论会调侃询问,并用一个因果读取所有预测. 以后的查询可以处理早期的查询,但没有插入引用或预测的答案. 两种模式都使用批量尺寸1.

blocks.en: VideoJev supports both modes for grounding and QA through direct candidate scores. Autoregressive Joint inference requires single-token answers read from each query’s next-token distribution. Multi-token outputs, including intervals, CoT, and Thinking, require sequential token feedback and thus use Cached inference . Their dotted curves in Figure 3 use this mode even when all queries are available together.

blocks.en: Direct predicts exactly one option token without reasoning. Figure 5 shows Qwen3.5-4B’s native non-thinking template. Cached reads option logits after one query suffix forward; Joint reads every Answer: position in one forward over complete turns with empty answer slots. Both mask logits to valid plain or leading-space option tokens before applying official sampling filters.
